info.name: Bliss aan — admin
info.description: Audience folder `admin/` (staff token: OTP login with `app=dashboard`, D29). Every route checks a permission. Editable text comes as `{ar, en}`. Slice 3: provider applications and standing.

request.description: Review queue, paginated. `q` searches name, legal name, phone. sort: submitted_at, -submitted_at (default), created_at, -created_at. Rows: id, provider_id, status, status_label, name, account_type(_label), city_id, city{ar,en}, phone, services_count, documents_total, documents_pending, submitted_at, created_at. Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN (not staff / missing permission) · 404 NOT_FOUND · 409 INVALID_STATE · 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.

200. Response `data` (ApplicationDetailResource): list fields + `status_reason, legal_name, representative_name, representative_title, email, phone_verified, bio, started_year, activated_at, services[{id,name{ar,en}}], coverage[{city_id,city{ar,en},districts[]}], working_hours[], past_work[{id,image,caption}], documents[{id,document_type_id,type_name{ar,en},file_name,mime,size_kb,preview (signed, 10 min),status,status_label,rejection_note,reviewed_by,uploaded_at}], missing_documents[{document_type_id,name{ar,en},is_required}], conflicts[], notes[{id,note_to_provider,internal_note,actor,created_at}], completion_requests[{id,items[],reason,internal_note,actor,created_at}], events[{id,kind,note,internal_note,actor,created_at}]`. Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN (not staff / missing permission) · 404 NOT_FOUND · 409 INVALID_STATE · 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.

Application `submitted`, document `pending` (else 409). Audited. 200 + detail. Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN (not staff / missing permission) · 404 NOT_FOUND · 409 INVALID_STATE · 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.

reason required ≤1000 (shown to the provider), internal_note ≤2000. 200 + detail. Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN (not staff / missing permission) · 404 NOT_FOUND · 409 INVALID_STATE · 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.

note_to_provider and/or internal_note (one required, ≤2000). submitted|needs_completion. 201 + detail. Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN (not staff / missing permission) · 404 NOT_FOUND · 409 INVALID_STATE · 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.

submitted → needs_completion. items[] 1–20 (≤300 each), reason required ≤1000 (shown to the provider), internal_note. 200 + detail. Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN (not staff / missing permission) · 404 NOT_FOUND · 409 INVALID_STATE · 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.

submitted → active. 409 when a document is not accepted or a required type is missing. reason, internal_note optional. 200 + detail. Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN (not staff / missing permission) · 404 NOT_FOUND · 409 INVALID_STATE · 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.

active → suspended; reason required (shown to the provider), internal_note. Hidden from discovery; history kept. 200 + application detail. Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN (not staff / missing permission) · 404 NOT_FOUND · 409 INVALID_STATE · 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.
suspended → active; reason required. 200 + application detail. Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN (not staff / missing permission) · 404 NOT_FOUND · 409 INVALID_STATE · 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.
Read-only. q: reference, client name or phone, provider name. Event dates are Riyadh dates. Rows add client{id,name,phone} and recipients_count.
Complete request incl. address details, pin and client phone (D64), recipients with declines, full history (internal too). attachments[].url is null without requests.attachments.view.
Needs requests.attachments.view too (super_admin only), else 403.

item.name: Cancellation requests (bookings.view / cancellations.decide)
item.description: Slice 6, D131. Request detail (Service requests) also carries booking.cancellation_requests and booking.review.

request.description: filter[status], filter[requester_role], sort=created_at|-created_at, page, per_page.
With the booking summary and internal_note.
Needs cancellations.decide. accept → booking + request cancelled (D128); reject → unchanged. Not under_review → 409 INVALID_STATE.

item.name: Staff accounts (roles.manage) — S14b
item.description: Slice 14b, D165–D170. Every route needs roles.manage.

request.description: q (name/phone), filter[role], filter[status] (active|suspended), sort name|created_at|last_login_at (− = desc), page, per_page ≤ 50.
With status_history (last 20 suspend/reactivate entries, internal note included). Non-admin id → 404.

D170: name, phone (Saudi mobile, normalised to E.164), optional email, one role. A phone used by any account (soft-deleted included) → 422. Non-super-admin: cannot assign super_admin or a role with permissions she lacks → 403 (D166).
Name and email only (phone not editable, D170). Acting on a super admin needs super_admin (D166).
Preview only: {staff_count, staff, added, removed}.
One role per staff member (D167). Own account → 409 OWN_ACCOUNT; last active super admin → 409 LAST_SUPER_ADMIN (D165); same role → 409 INVALID_STATE.
Disable = suspend (D170): reason is shown to her, internal_note is not; every session is revoked. Own account → 409 OWN_ACCOUNT; last active super admin → 409 LAST_SUPER_ADMIN.
Not suspended → 409 INVALID_STATE. She signs in again with OTP.
System roles first (AdminRole order), then custom. Each: label, labels (custom only), is_system, is_editable (false for super_admin), restricted_permissions, permissions, staff_count, updated_at/by.
Preview only. requests.attachments.view for a role other than super_admin → 422 PERMISSION_RESTRICTED (D169).

Full permission set + reason. super_admin → 409 (fixed, D165); requests.attachments.view on any other role → 422 PERMISSION_RESTRICTED (D169); no change → 409 INVALID_STATE; granting what you lack (non-super-admin) → 403 (D166).
D168: key ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{2,39}$ (immutable), label {ar, en}, permissions, reason. requests.attachments.view → 422 PERMISSION_RESTRICTED.
Custom roles only; system role → 409 INVALID_STATE.
Only when nobody (active or suspended) holds it → 204; otherwise 409 ROLE_IN_USE; system role → 409 INVALID_STATE.

clients.view. Only users.type=client. q = name, email or phone. filter[status] ∈ active · suspended · pending_deletion. sort ∈ created_at, name, bookings_count (± prefix). orders_count is null until store orders exist. 422 on an unknown filter/sort.

clients.view. Adds open_items {requests, bookings}, active_sessions, linked (latest 20 requests: reference + status only), status_logs (account_status_logs, newest first, sessions_revoked on suspensions), deletion_request (null until Slice 12). Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN (not staff / missing permission) · 404 NOT_FOUND (not a client)

clients.edit (D174): name, email, city only, reason required; phone is never editable here. Logged (status log client_updated + audit old/new). Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN (not staff / missing permission) · 404 NOT_FOUND (not a client) · 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.

clients.suspend (D171, D173): active/pending_deletion → suspended; reason shown to her at login (403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED + errors.reason). Revokes ALL her sessions (revoked_at, fcm_token cleared): her tokens answer 401. Nothing else changes on her requests/bookings. Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN (not staff / missing permission) · 404 NOT_FOUND (not a client) · 409 INVALID_STATE (already suspended) · 422.

clients.suspend (D173): suspended → the status before the suspension (active or pending_deletion). No session is restored: she signs in again. Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN (not staff / missing permission) · 404 NOT_FOUND (not a client) · 409 INVALID_STATE (not suspended) · 422.

providers.view. Activated providers only (active / suspended). Each row: account_name, is_verified, is_featured, is_visible (D75), rating, reviews_count, services_count. sort ∈ activated_at, created_at, rating, display_name (± prefix).

providers.view. Services (money objects, places), coverage, portfolio incl. hidden items, open_items {recipients_new, offers_active, bookings_open} (D172), logs with reasons. Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN · 404 NOT_FOUND (not an activated provider)

providers.verify (D175): {value, reason, internal_note?}; active or suspended; manual badge; no notification. Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN · 404 NOT_FOUND (not an activated provider) · 409 INVALID_STATE (already that value) · 422.
providers.verify (D175, D32): {value, reason, internal_note?}; home shows up to 10 featured. Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN · 404 NOT_FOUND (not an activated provider) · 409 INVALID_STATE · 422.

providers.review (D176): reason required; hidden from every public list; the provider sees hidden_by_admin + hidden_reason in GET provider/profile. Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN · 404 NOT_FOUND (not an activated provider) · 409 INVALID_STATE (already hidden) · 422.
providers.review (D176). Errors: 401 · 403 FORBIDDEN · 404 NOT_FOUND (not an activated provider) · 409 INVALID_STATE (not hidden).
bookings.view (§5.1). Rows with has_pending_cancellation and open_tickets_count.
bookings.view. Address with pin (D64), cancellation_requests (+refunds), review with moderation fields, payment (Slice 10 summary or null), tickets, history (staff view), staff_notes, actions.
bookings.intervene (D256). confirmed/in_progress only; pending party request → 409 CANCELLATION_PENDING. E23 to both. No refund: use Slice 10's refund endpoint.
bookings.intervene (D256). in_progress only (409 otherwise); repeat = 200 unchanged. E24 to both.
bookings.intervene. Internal history entry; no notification.
bookings.intervene (D256). awaiting_offers/offers_received only. E3 to providers still taking part, E22 to the client.
bookings.intervene. Internal.
bookings.view. Rows gain payment + refunds (Slice 10).
support.view (§6). filter[assigned] = me | none | any | staff id.
support.view. messages (kind user/reply/note), history, chat {available, conversations_count, can_review}, chat_access_logs, actions.
support.assign (D259). assignee_id = active staff with support.reply, or null.
support.reply. Only an unassigned ticket (409 otherwise).
support.reply (D258). open/in_progress → waiting; closed → 409. E20 to the user. 201 / 200 replay.
support.reply. is_internal, never shown to the user.
support.reply (D258). Reason required to close or reopen. E21 on resolved (or closed straight from an open state).
chats.view_for_ticket + assignee (D260). No messages.
chats.view_for_ticket + assignee; ticket not closed. One conversation_access_logs row per page. Returns access_log_id, messages, meta.has_more/next_before.
Within support.chat_access_minutes of that log row (else 409); logged again.
reviews.moderate (§8).
reviews.moderate (D261). Rating recomputed; open reports closed as actioned.
reviews.moderate.
reviews.moderate (D262). Open first.
reviews.moderate (D262). actioned hides the review and closes its other open reports; dismissed closes one.
